spell.aurorion_magia.dolor_cruciatus.gui: Channel pure pain into a target in sight. While it lasts, they bleed quickly and the agony keeps them from walking or jumping.
spell.aurorion_magia.imperium_mentis.gui: Impose your will on a mind. Creatures fight for you; people lose their bearings and cannot cast or use what they hold.
spell.aurorion_magia.vinculum_carnificis: Vinculum Carnificis. Where the target was struck becomes the anchor of an invisible chain. They may walk, fight and cast freely — but crossing the limit yanks them back, harder each time. Pearls and teleports won't save them.
spell.aurorion_magia.furtum_impetus.guid: Furtum Impetus. Steal the motion of a creature, arrow or thrown item and hold it in your hand. Cast again to release it into another target, in the direction you look. With no target, it steals your own momentum — or releases it into you.
spell.aurorion_magia.transpositio.guide: Transpositio. You and the target swap places in an instant — and swap speed and fall as well. Save an ally, trap an enemy or escape a siege.
spell.aurorion_magia.manus_carnificis.gu: Manus Carnificis. Hold a creature in the air and steer it with your gaze. Release to hurl it — hitting a wall hurts.
spell.aurorion_magia.manus_vacua.guide: Manus Vacua. Rip the item from the target's hand and throw it to the ground. While sneaking, takes the off-hand instead: shield, totem, focus.
spell.aurorion_magia.genua_flecte.guide: Genua Flecte. "Bend the knee." The target falls to their knees before you: barely able to move, no jumping, no running — but they can still speak.
spell.aurorion_magia.vox_interdicta.guid: Vox Interdicta. Take someone's voice. For a few seconds nothing they say is heard, in chat or voice, and no spell leaves their lips.
spell.aurorion_magia.sigillum_clausum.gu: Sigillum Clausum. Seal a door, trapdoor, gate, chest or barrel. No one opens it but you — and, with greater mastery, your team. A seal of equal or higher level breaks yours.
spell.aurorion_magia.deiectio_corporis.g: Deiectio Corporis. A brutal force drives the target into the ground, stripping wings, flight and levitation. Those already grounded take the impact and cannot jump for a moment.
spell.aurorion_magia.lux_vorata.guide: Lux Vorata. Snuffs out candles and campfires around you and leaves a thick darkness in their place for a few seconds.
spell.aurorion_magia.ferrum_ligatum.guid: Ferrum Ligatum. The target's armor and off-hand item are bound to their body: they won't come off, swap or drop.

ui.aurorion_magia.lacre_time: You and your team can open
aurorion_magia.inscricao_negada: You cannot inscribe %s: this spell was not taught to you.
aurorion_magia.mente_turva: Your mind is not your own. No spell answers.
aurorion_magia.corrente: The chain won't let you go.
aurorion_magia.nada_a_roubar: There is no motion to steal.
aurorion_magia.desarmado: Something tore away what you were holding.
aurorion_magia.ferro_vinculado: The iron closes over your body.
aurorion_magia.nada_a_lacrar: There is nothing here that can be sealed.
aurorion_magia.lacre.resisted: The seal holds: a stronger hand made it.
aurorion_magia.lacre.full: There are too many seals in this world.
spell.aurorion_magia.tempus_sistere.guid: Tempus Sistere. Forbidden spell. Everything around you stops — people, creatures, arrows in flight — except you. No one moves, strikes or uses anything; they can only look. Radius and duration grow with mastery.
spell.aurorion_magia.mortem_dico.guide: Mortem Dico. Forbidden spell. "I declare death." The target dies at once: no armor, enchantment, shield or totem saves them.
spell.aurorion_magia.dolor_universus.gui: Dolor Universus. Forbidden spell. Everyone around you is lifted off the ground and held in the air, paralyzed by pain, bleeding for as long as you sustain it. Radius, height and pain grow with mastery.
